rules.name: regime_environmental_compound
rules.notes: Fires on matrix-PERMITTED trades when >=2 of {rotational regime, exhaustion, unhealthy vol} compound. Tests whether allowed-but-compound-hostile trades lose money.

rules.name: delivery_continuation_objection
rules.notes: Continuation playbook with measured-broken delivery (intact=false, confidence<40). Covers delivery quality - inexpressible in the 5F matrix. Never fires on missing data.

rules.name: reversal_without_evidence
rules.notes: Reversal playbook without measured sweep+reclaim or MSS - narrative-only reversals (the June 10 pattern).

rules.name: range_rotation_continuation_forbidden
rules.notes: 5F.2 matrix law: continuation playbooks forbidden in range_rotation; reversal-only at cap 0.5, confirmed trigger, min age 2. Authored, validated against n=1.

rules.name: chop_reversal_only_quarter_risk
rules.notes: 5F.2 matrix law: chop allows reversal playbooks only, cap 0.25, confirmed trigger, min age 3. Authored, untested.

rules.name: exhaustion_risk_overlay
rules.notes: 5F.2 overlay: exhaustion_risk forbids continuation, requires confirmed trigger, caps risk at 0.5, min age 2. Authored, validated against n=1.

rules.name: volatility_overlay_caps
rules.notes: 5F.2 overlay: unstable vol caps 0.5, severe vol caps 0.25; confirmed trigger required outside strong trend. Authored, untested.

rules.name: trigger_confirmation_enforcement
rules.notes: 5F.3 gate law: required_trigger_status from matrix; confirmation_needed != confirmed; missing matrix defaults to require confirmed. Validated against n=1.

rules.name: minimum_setup_age
rules.notes: 5F.5 gate law: min_setup_age_scans by regime (trend=1, range/exhaustion=2, chop=3). Validated against n=1.

rules.name: risk_multiplier_enforcement
rules.notes: 5F.1 sizing law: effective budget = base x min(governor multiplier, regime cap). Annotation class - modulates size, does not block.
